name: jev-prompt
description: Grades the prompt you are typing against a prompting rubric, live, with Jev through OpenRouter.

openrouterApiKey.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouterApiKey.description: Key used for Jev decisions calls. Kept in secure storage.

model.title: Jev model
model.description: Pinned exact: weights are calibrated per Jev version.

idleMs.title: Idle before grading (ms)
idleMs.description: How long typing must pause before a grade.

requireEndPunctuation.title: Require end punctuation
requireEndPunctuation.description: Grade only drafts ending in . ? or ! (still after the idle wait).

monthlyBudgetUsd.title: Monthly budget (USD)
monthlyBudgetUsd.description: Hard cap per calendar month, shared by all sessions.

dailyBudgetUsd.title: Daily budget (USD)
dailyBudgetUsd.description: Hard cap per local day, shared by all sessions.

priceUsdPerMTok.title: Price per million input tokens (USD)
priceUsdPerMTok.description: Used only for the pre-call cost estimate.

timeoutMs.title: Request timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: A slower answer shows the band as offline.

requireZdr.title: Require zero data retention
requireZdr.description: Route only to OpenRouter endpoints with zero data retention.

promptCommands.title: Slash commands that take a prompt
promptCommands.description: Comma-separated names without the slash. The text after them is graded. Empty turns this off.
